title: M9-C42.25 / M25.1 — transaction_intelligence Forensic Inventory
methodology: Complete source inspection (all 5 modules read line-by-line) + coverage.py missing-line analysis (17.5% at entry) + grep-based caller mapping. No tests written before this inventory.
architecture: Pure-function detector layer. No database access; all data passed as parameters by src/services/transaction_intelligence_service.py and src/orchestration/statement_orchestrator.py. Monetary values: integer paise.

modules.role: Frozen dataclass result contracts shared by all detectors

decision_branches: provider pattern match vs unknown-provider path
unknown provider: liquidity keyword gate, savings/current + same household + amount window (credit < debit, credit > 10000) filters, closest-to-225bps selection
known provider: account type / household / settlement-window (0..settlement_days+2) / amount (< debit) eligibility filters
zone classification: auto (fee_min..fee_max inclusive) / review (review range inclusive) / None discard
disambiguation: auto preferred over review, then closest to fee-range midpoint (auto) or lowest fee_bps (review)
confidence: base 8000 auto / 5500 review, +1000 confirmed_by_user, +1000 due-date proximity 0..7 days (3 date formats), cap 9900
purpose pattern matching, narrative construction, match_reason
error_paths: invalid ISO date -> None parse / 999-day sentinel

anomalies.description: best_credit selection computes _calculate_fee_bps(debit_amount_paise, credit_amount_paise - target_bps) — subtracts 225 (a basis-points value) from a paise amount. Effectively shifts fee by 22500/debit bps rather than selecting credit closest to 225 bps fee. Likely defect, but intent cannot be proven from code alone.
anomalies.disposition: AMBIGUOUS -> explicitly recorded, NOT silently assigned. Tests pin current behavior and document the anomaly; no production change in C42.25 (would alter certified-baseline semantics).

why_coverage_is_low: The package has NEVER had direct tests. The ~17.5% measured coverage comes exclusively from statement_orchestrator integration paths and credit_cards property tests, which touch only the detector entry guards (debit<=0 early returns, non-matching descriptions) and dataclass definitions. All classification math, zone logic, priority scoring, and confidence computation are genuinely untested (class A).
